industry: Measuring, Medical, Optical and Related Instruments

instrument_device_family.label: Instrument / device family
instrument_device_family.value: Water meters, flow meters, cellular AMI endpoints, water quality probes and monitors, pressure and water level sensors, flow and energy instrumentation, and gas detectors.

measurement_performance_specification.label: Measurement / performance specification
measurement_performance_specification.value: High-resolution flow data for HVAC, high-frequency pressure monitoring for drinking water networks, and real-time water quality measurements for treatment.

clinical_industrial_research_use.label: Clinical / industrial / research use
clinical_industrial_research_use.value: Municipal water metering, distribution monitoring, drinking water and wastewater treatment, industrial process control and gas safety, and commercial HVAC energy management.

product_specific_regulatory_status.label: Product-specific regulatory status
product_specific_regulatory_status.value: Nonmedical water and industrial instrumentation. ORION Cellular is accredited under IoT Network Certified for Smart Connected Infrastructure.

consumables_service_attachment.label: Consumables / service attachment
consumables_service_attachment.value: Software as a service, training and solution delivery, and reagent-free distribution monitoring.

notes: Calibration and qualification requirements remain unclear.
